implication: A Regulation 31(4) disclosure is a mandatory open market acquisition notification; where a single acquirer breaches 25% shareholding threshold or makes a public announcement, the full takeover code framework applies—requiring OFS, independent valuers, and SEBI clearance if applicable.

headline: Naresh Kumar Bansal files substantial acquisition disclosure under SEBI Takeover Code
sum: Naresh Kumar Bansal submitted a Regulation 31(4) disclosure under the SEBI (Substantial Acquisition of Shares and Takeovers) Regulations, 2011 to NSE, signalling a material change in shareholding or takeover intent in Rama Steel Tubes Limited.
detail: The disclosure was filed by Naresh Kumar Bansal with the NSE on or around 6 July 2026. Regulation 31(4) of the SEBI (Takeovers) Regulations, 2011 mandates disclosure when a person acquires shares or voting rights in a company in such quantity as to trigger substantial acquisition thresholds (25% or higher) or when a public announcement is made. The company is listed on NSE (ticker RAMASTEEL). No settlement value, acquisition percentage, or binding conditions are disclosed in available public sources.
